ironmanGuide.desc: This section goes over your starting Weapon, Tools, Armor, and unlocking Carpentry and Taming.
ironmanGuide.title: Fresh Profile

ironmanGuide.desc: This section goes over early game upgrades that aren't a major time investment.
ironmanGuide.title: Cheap Upgrades

ironmanGuide.desc: After giving Rhys the materials, you will unlock Heart of the Mountain and be warped to Dwarven Mines, the best island for most of the Mining Resources. Be sure to talk to Rhys inside the Dwarven Mines, as he will teach you everything you n
ironmanGuide.title: The Dwarven Mines - Mining Progression

ironmanGuide.desc: Craft a Cleaver, then travel to the Dungeon Hub, speak to Ophelia and buy a Super Cleaver for 80k. It should also be enchanted and reforged.
ironmanGuide.title: The End Island - Combat Progression

ironmanGuide.desc: Zombie Slayer is the simplest of the slayers. The Revenant Horror simply runs towards the player in the first two tiers. Tier III adds an enraged ability that increases the damage and speed considerably after 40 seconds for 12 seconds. Upon
ironmanGuide.title: Zombie Slayer

ironmanGuide.desc: The first two tiers of Spider Slayer are pretty much the same as Zombie Slayer. At Tier 3 the Tarantula Broodfather will spawn egg sacs in the air above it. Use a Shortbow to take care of the eggs to make the boss vulnerable again.
ironmanGuide.title: Spider Slayer

ironmanGuide.desc: The first tier is simple enough, but at tier two the Sven Packmaster will start dealing True Damage, ignoring your Defense. Upon death you will be rewarded with Wolf Teeth.
ironmanGuide.title: Wolf Slayer

ironmanGuide.desc: One of the main features of The End is the Dragons, spawned in the Dragon's Nest with Summoning Eyes. There are 7 different types of Dragons, each with different amounts of health and different drops. Summoning Eyes are obtained as a guaran
ironmanGuide.title: Further End Progression

ironmanGuide.desc: Dungeons unlock at Combat 15. They are randomly generated sets of rooms that have to be moved through. At the end of each floor, there is a boss.
ironmanGuide.title: Dungeons

ironmanGuide.desc: At SkyBlock Level 4, the Garden is unlocked. This is your own personal farm where you can plant crops to harvest in the most efficient way possible. Work through the progression of Farming Armor by crafting your Farmhand Armor into Haymaker
ironmanGuide.title: Farming

ironmanGuide.desc: Complete commissions until you reaching Heart of the Mountain level 4, which will grant you access to the Crystal Hollows. Talk to Gwendolyn to obtain a Crystal Hollows Pass, after which you can enter via the minecart or through a portal on
ironmanGuide.title: Mining

ironmanGuide.desc: After finishing the main quests in The Park, continue chopping Jungle Wood until you can make a Treecapitator. Galatea is the main area where you will be Foraging, and it can be unlocked at Foraging 12. First do the tutorial. Then, chop dow
ironmanGuide.title: Moonglade Marsh

ironmanGuide.desc: The next Foraging Island is the Torrhus Canyon, which unlocks at HOTF 4. The Helix Trees here have high Toughness, which makes them difficult to break efficiently if you have low Sweep. It is recommended to harvest some useful Attributes he
ironmanGuide.title: Torrhus Canyon

FARMING.desc: Public-island crops are fine for the first few Farming levels and Collections. A Rookie Hoe and Rookie Farming Axe from the Farm Merchant are cheap starter tools and each grant +5. Apply Harvesting as soon as it is available.
FARMING.title: Stage 1: Unlocking the Garden and reaching Farming 20

FARMING.desc: At Farming 10, you can enter Jacob's Farming Contests. Each contest lasts for 20 minutes and chooses three crops. Early contests are useful for extra progression, but prioritizing them is not needed.
FARMING.title: Contests while progressing

FARMING.desc: It is important for Players to understand that the following progression is largely working towards the goal of 40 where Player's unlock Fermento Armor.
FARMING.title: Stage 2: Farming 20-29 and building the setup

FARMING.desc: At 30, upgrade to Cropie Armor, then to Squash Armor at 35. Keep using the same armor chain rather than buying unrelated temporary sets.
FARMING.title: Stage 3: Farming 30-39 and preparing for Pests

FARMING.desc: Reaching 40 farming Mushrooms is no longer recomended. Players should switch to crops such as Wheat, Melon, Sunflower or Moonflower. Spend most active Farming time on crop progression, income, contests, and Pest Farming.
FARMING.title: Stage 4: Farming 40-49 and starting Pest Farming

FARMING.desc: At 50, upgrade to Helianthus Armor. Keep earning Gold in unique Jacob's Farming Contest crops and buying the Farming level cap upgrades from Anita until 60 is unlocked.
FARMING.title: Stage 5: Farming 50-60 and late Farming progression

FARMING.desc: Do not rush several duplicate sets as soon as you reach 50. Start with one strong Helianthus Armor set plus Rooted Blossom Set for normal farming and a Squeaky Pesthunter's Set for spawning. The extra armor and equipment sets only become wo
FARMING.title: Second Farming Set

FARMING.desc: A Legendary Elephant Pet is the better option when Collection is the main goal unless you can reach around 1,429 with a Mooshroom Cow Pet. Below this breakpoint, Elephant gives more Farming Fortune, while Mooshroom Cow will usually make aro
FARMING.title: Farming Fortune and crop income

FARMING.desc: A simple way to think about Pest pets is to keep a separate pet for each phase:
FARMING.title: Pest Farming

FARMING.desc: An upgrade is not useful only because it adds Farming Fortune. Visitor progress, Tool XP, Crop Milestones, Pest Bestiary, , Greenhouse unlocks, Attributes, and pet progression can be worth more than a small immediate stat increase.
FARMING.title: Farming Fortune and related progression

FARMING.desc: [https://eliteskyblock.com/ Elite Skyblock] can be used to check your Farming profile instead of following a generic upgrade list blindly. The [https://eliteskyblock.com/fortune Fortune] page shows Farming Fortune progress and a personalize
FARMING.title: Checking personal Farming progression

FISHING.desc: It is recommended to place down Lily Pad Minions and grind out Exploding Lily Pads in the Lotus Atoll to obtain Enchanted Lily Pads quickly for both this and the Rod of Legends.
FISHING.title: Water

FISHING.desc: Additionally, a Starter Lava Rod without any Enchantments is required to fish up Vanille Trophy Fish.
FISHING.title: Lava

FISHING.desc: A set of Angler Armor can be purchased from the Fishing Merchant for a total of 400 coins. Each piece costs 100 coins.
FISHING.title: Armor Progression

FISHING.desc: You should use a Backwater Necklace until you obtain a Thunderbolt Necklace.
FISHING.title: Equipment Progression

FISHING.desc: Unlike most other parts of fishing progression, Bait does not improve linearly. Instead, you use certain types of Bait depending on your stage in the game.
FISHING.title: Bait Progression

FORAGING.desc: This section goes over each part of progression generally; the rest of the guide should also be read to get an idea of what upgrades to get specifically.
FORAGING.title: General Progression

FORAGING.desc: If on a Regular profile, buy a Fig Hew immediately after unlocking the Moonglade Marsh, and Fig Armor immediately after getting Foraging 15. If on an Ironman profile, use a Seriously Damaged Axe instead, until you have enough materials to c
FORAGING.title: Moonglade Marsh

FORAGING.title: Torrhus Canyon

HUNTING.title: Tools
